title: Kissed Mexican Tacos
description: A fusion of sweet and savory flavors in a crispy taco shell.
instructions: Cook ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it into small pieces.
Add taco seasoning to the pan and stir to combine.
Stir in kissed dish sauce and cook for an additional minute.
Warm tortillas in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
Assemble tacos by spooning beef mixture onto a warmed tortilla, followed by a spoonful of shredded cheese, a few leaves of lettuce, a few diced tomatoes, and a slice of avocado.
Top with a dollop of sour cream and serve immediately.
